qa.title: Q1303 (Jun. 13, 2025)
qa.question: If I have 4 cards on my field including this follower when playing its Fanfare ability, what happens?
qa.answer: You would resolve the ability as normal, except you would choose 1 of the revealed followers to summon and shuffle the other with the rest of the revealed cards before putting them on the bottom of your deck.

qa.title: Q1302 (Jun. 13, 2025)
qa.question: If I reveal all the cards in my deck and only reveal 1 follower that costs 3 or less, do I still summon that follower?
qa.answer: Yes, you do.

qa.title: Q1301 (Jun. 13, 2025)
qa.question: If I reveal all the cards in my deck and don't reveal any followers that cost 3 or less, what happens?
qa.answer: You would shuffle all the cards you revealed and put them back in the deck area.

qa.title: Q1300 (Jun. 13, 2025)
qa.question: If I evolve this follower with its automatic ability, can I evolve another follower using its evolve ability in the same turn?
qa.answer: Yes. Although you can only activate one evolve ability per turn, other abilities that evolve followers do not count towards this limit.

qa.title: Q1529 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: There are 10 or more cards in my cemetery. If I summon and destroy this follower with Nephthys's Fanfare ability, can I select this follower in the cemetery when resolving its own Fanfare ability?
qa.answer: Yes. It is in the cemetery by the time you resolve its Fanfare ability, so you may select it. If you do, you do not banish it. Additionally, if you choose to resolve its Last Words ability after its Fanfare ability, you do not put it into its owner's EX area.

qa.title: Q1528 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: There are 10 or more cards in my cemetery. If I summon and destroy this follower with Nephthys's Fanfare ability, then resolve this follower's Fanfare ability and summon a Wasteland follower that costs 3 or less from my cemetery, do I banish this follower?
qa.answer: No. It is no longer on the field by the time you resolve its Fanfare ability.

qa.title: Q1527 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: If I summon and destroy this follower with Nephthys's Fanfare ability, can I resolve this follower's Last Words ability before its Fanfare ability?
qa.answer: Yes. Since its Last Words ability and Fanfare ability would both be pending at the same time, you may resolve them in any order.

qa.title: Q1526 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: If my EX area is full, and this follower is put into the cemetery from the field, how should I resolve its Last Words ability?
qa.answer: It remains in the cemetery.

qa.title: Q1537 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: My opponent has an evolved Ginsetsu, Great Fox and an evolved Shuten-Doji on their field, and they attack my leader with the latter. I play this spell at quick timing, giving the evolved Shuten-Doji -2 attack and defense. Since the evolved Ginsetsu, Great Fox's ability increases Yokai followers' damage dealt by 1, does my leader take 1 damage?
qa.answer: No. A follower with 0 or less attack doesn't deal damage, and Ginsetsu, Great Fox's "if a Yokai follower on your field would deal damage, it deals that much plus 1 instead" only takes effect when damage is dealt.

qa.title: Q1536 (Sep. 19, 2025)
qa.question: Can a follower have negative attack?
qa.answer: Yes. A follower's attack can be reduced to a negative number by effects. A follower with negative attack doesn't deal attack or combat damage.
